name: loom
description: A delivery layer for coding agents that turns product requests into planned, verified, deployable software changes.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.check: npm run build && node tests/run-suite.js project delivery-reference-sync && node tests/run-suite.js knowledge adapter-routing
scripts.test: npm run build && node tests/run-suite.js all
scripts.test:deploy: npm run build && node tests/run-suite.js deploy
scripts.test:brainstorm: npm run build && node tests/run-suite.js brainstorm
scripts.test:architecture: npm run build && node tests/run-suite.js architecture
scripts.test:task: npm run build && node tests/run-suite.js task
scripts.test:knowledge: npm run build && node tests/run-suite.js knowledge
scripts.test:protocol: npm run build && node tests/run-suite.js protocol
scripts.test:adapters: npm run build && node tests/run-suite.js adapters
scripts.test:review: npm run build && node tests/run-suite.js review
scripts.test:project: npm run build && node tests/run-suite.js project
scripts.plugin:install-adapters: npm run build && node scripts/refresh-local-codex-plugin.js && node scripts/refresh-local-claude-plugin.js && node scripts/refresh-local-opencode-plugin.js
